overview:
**Very High fire danger continues today, driven by critically dry fuels — ERC at 91%, exceeding the local watchout threshold.**
- Danger eases toward midweek, dropping to High by Monday as ERC and BI percentiles decline into the 70s-80s.
- Dry NE winds near 12 mph and low humidity (26%) with zero rain are keeping fuels stressed; light rain chances build later this week.
- 1 of 7 local watchout thresholds is currently met (ERC); no Red Flag Warning is in effect per NWS.
- Stage 1 Fire Restrictions are in effect in unincorporated Montrose County effective September 4, 2026, with similar Stage 1 limits active in Delta and Ouray counties and on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands; the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forests have removed all fire restrictions effective September 3, 2026.
- Nearby: the Elk Fire seven miles northwest of Lake City (Hinsdale County) is 7,257 acres and 73% contained, with structures threatened and area, road and trail closures in effect.
